summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Corp (BIPC), a British Columbia corporation, filed a 6-K disclosing an arrangement agreement dated July 21, 2026, among BIPC, Brookfield Infrastructure Partners Inc. (BIP Inc.), and Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. (BIP). The arrangement aims to consolidate the business under BIP Inc., delivering benefits to unitholders and shareholders. Both the BIP Board and BIPC Board, based on unanimous recommendations from their special committees and fairness opinions from Scotia Capital Inc., approved the deal. No price or premium is stated. The transaction is subject to interim order, meeting approvals, and regulatory filings. Key watch item: shareholder vote and regulatory timeline.
